prompts.task:
$otel-instrument

Work in ./service. Copy eval/inputs/native-resource-audit.json to .observe/otel-audit.json and select AO-001,AO-002,AO-003 through the bundled flow. Accepted Studio Project: model-directed-demo; Agent Stream: model-directed-agent. Preserve native producers and existing sinks. Use actual native libraries with isolated local resource/OTLP fakes, without live models, cloud credentials or browsers. Exercise connected, disconnected, unavailable and reconnected launches; leave unrelated telemetry unselected.

judge_inputs: Inspect actual source/configuration diff, canonical audit/selection/report digests, real local bootstrap/API/export requests, and executed app startup/profile tests.
rubric:
Rule: Consumes the supplied canonical Project, dedicated Agent Stream and native runtime-routing configuration findings; selects those IDs and their justified executable prerequisites with canonical bindings, without requiring an AO span-creation SDK.
Example: Select the supplied native project/stream/routing findings with canonical bindings.
Evidence: Inspect the selected application path, actual changes, commands and bound reports for this rule. Require execution only where the rule calls for it; keep unselected branches outside its scope.
Insufficient evidence: Ignoring the supplied selected configuration findings because no AO SDK was imported.

Rule: Implements resource resolution through supported SDK-free interfaces, preserving native producers/providers/exporters and real endpoints/protocol/nondefault port. No splunk-ao dependency, second provider or duplicate destination export is introduced. Any startup repair is limited to source-proven prerequisites.
Example: Resolve targets with native interfaces while retaining existing exporters.
Evidence: Inspect the selected application path, actual changes, commands and bound reports for this rule. Require execution only where the rule calls for it; keep unselected branches outside its scope.
Insufficient evidence: A new span SDK/provider, duplicate sink or unrelated startup rewrite.

Rule: Actually executes written bootstrap and local HTTP API cases for reuse/create/mixed/repeat, ownership, lookup-only IDs, duplicate/uncertain outcome relookup, lookup/create failures and ordinary-telemetry continuation. Fake SDK modules or replacement resolver logic do not prove the actual path.
Example: Run the written bootstrap against local resource API scenarios.
Evidence: Inspect the selected application path, actual changes, commands and bound reports for this rule. Require execution only where the rule calls for it; keep unselected branches outside its scope.
Insufficient evidence: A fake SDK module or replacement resolver offered as proof.

Rule: Actual application launch loads persisted resolved UUIDs into OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_HEADERS or the existing supported constructor hook before export; captured native trace HTTP requests contain correct projectid/logstreamid for the chosen Studio contract. Tests preserve harmless generic fallback/trace-specific precedence and prove no route/auth leakage into metrics/logs. Unused example env assignments or direct environment injection that bypasses the written launcher are insufficient.
Example: Launch with persisted routing IDs and inspect native HTTP headers.
Evidence: Inspect the selected application path, actual changes, commands and bound reports for this rule. Require execution only where the rule calls for it; keep unselected branches outside its scope.
Insufficient evidence: Environment injection that bypasses the written launch/profile path.

Rule: Native operation/export receipts, flush/shutdown and source-bound reports prove local configuration/runtime outcomes without inventing model or remote resource/trace visibility. Remote exact destination trace proof remains explicitly Not proven or Blocked; report unselected gaps separately and do not claim full readiness from unit/source/HTTP acknowledgement.
Example: Retain native operation and lifecycle receipts with source-bound reports.
Evidence: Inspect the selected application path, actual changes, commands and bound reports for this rule. Require execution only where the rule calls for it; keep unselected branches outside its scope.
Insufficient evidence: An acknowledgement or unit test called live cloud destination proof.

Rule: Actual bootstrap/launch tests prove connected routed UUID headers, running-disconnected resource503 with zero create calls and ordinary local agent telemetry/business continuation, Studio-unavailable local/in-memory execution with receiver receipt blocked, and recovery with stable IDs/zero duplicate creates. A previously validated complete same-destination binding works across reconnect and new launches without gating exports on resource relookup; names-only and changed/rejected identity cases require their distinct scoped resolution path. Previously validated same-destination IDs remain in headers and trace Resources during503; unknown names remain selectors and recover automatically in one PID without manual setup. Harmless headers and unrelated sinks survive. Local emission and routed/cloud outcomes are independently reported, without silent destination changes or fabricated delivery.
Example: Exercise disconnect/reconnect and names-only recovery without changing sinks.
Evidence: Inspect the selected application path, actual changes, commands and bound reports for this rule. Require execution only where the rule calls for it; keep unselected branches outside its scope.
Insufficient evidence: Duplicate creates, lost validated bindings or fabricated delivery.
